full_prompt_en: A square Post-Impressionist oil painting shows two dark-coated figures standing on a cobbled quay and looking across a glowing industrial harbor at dusk. The sky fills the upper third with a dense weave of short cream, peach, lavender, and turquoise strokes. Along the far bank, low gray buildings, thin chimneys, masts, and a large rectangular factory rise through lavender haze. Several smoke plumes drift upward and blend into the stippled sky. On the left, a dark moored vessel and upright masts press into the water, their shapes partly swallowed by cool shadow. The harbor basin occupies the middle of the image and reflects the sunset as broken horizontal dashes of gold, mint green, blue, and violet. The brightest vertical reflection runs down from the pale sky near the center toward the foreground. At the lower right, a diagonal stone edge separates the water from an orange-brown cobbled walkway. Two figures stand along that edge, one slightly forward and to the left of the other. Their long dark coats and hats are rendered almost as silhouettes, with their faces indistinct; both face left toward the river activity. A tall dark building crops the right edge, its small warm-lit windows echoing the gold in the water. The fading light comes from the distant sky across the harbor, so the foreground figures and vessels remain dark against the reflected brightness. Every surface is built from small separate strokes rather than smooth gradients, and the stone path has a mosaic-like rhythm of orange and violet marks. There is no readable text. The overall composition is atmospheric and balanced, using the near-dark verticals to frame a luminous band of water and an industrious, hazy horizon.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形后印象派油画呈现两位穿深色外套的人物站在石铺码头上，于黄昏凝望发光的工业港湾。天空占据上方三分之一，由密集的乳白、桃色、淡紫和青绿短笔触交织而成。对岸低矮灰色建筑、细烟囱、桅杆和一座大型矩形工厂从淡紫雾气里升起。几股烟向上飘散，融进点状笔触的天空。左侧一艘停泊的深色船和竖直桅杆压入水面，形体部分被冷色阴影吞没。港湾水域占据画面中部，把落日映成断续横向的金、薄荷绿、蓝与紫色短线。最亮的一道竖向反光从中央附近的浅色天空一直延伸到前景。右下方，斜向石沿将水面与橙棕色石铺步道分开。两位人物站在石沿旁，一位稍向前且偏左，另一位在其后。长深色外套与帽子几乎画成剪影，面孔不清；两人都朝左望向河面活动。右侧边缘裁入一幢高大的深色建筑，几扇暖色亮窗呼应水里的金色。衰退的光从港湾对岸天空照来，因此前景人物和船只在反光前保持深色。每处表面都由分离的小笔触建立，而非平滑渐层，石路带有橙紫笔痕组成的马赛克节奏。没有可读文字。整体构图有浓厚空气感且平衡，以近处深色竖形框住明亮水带和忙碌而朦胧的地平线。
style_prompt_en: The oil painting relies on small discrete dabs and short directional strokes that let adjacent colors mingle in the eye. Cool turquoise, blue, and violet are interspersed with peach, amber, and warm cream, producing shimmer without smooth blending. Reflections break into horizontal fragments, while vertical structural marks give a steady counter-rhythm. Distant forms lose precise edges in colored haze; nearer dark masses stay simple and solid against the luminous middle ground. The sky and ground are equally textured, their marks changing direction to distinguish air, water, and firm surface. Backlight holds foreground shapes close to silhouette and concentrates brightness along a broad central band. Perspective is carried by a diagonal edge and the decreasing scale of fine marks toward the horizon. The overall effect is hazy, active, and luminous, with the visible division of colored paint acting as the chief stylistic mechanism.
style_prompt_zh: 这种油画依靠分离的小色点和短促方向性笔触，让相邻颜色在观者眼中融合。冷调青绿、蓝和紫与桃色、琥珀色及暖乳白交错，形成无需平滑调和的闪烁感。反射光碎成横向片段，竖向构造笔痕提供稳定的对位节奏。远处形体在彩色雾气里失去精确边缘，近处深色大形则在发光的中景前保持简单坚实。天空与地面都有相同密度的肌理，笔痕改变方向以区分空气、水面和坚硬表面。逆光让前景形体接近剪影，并把亮度集中在宽阔的中央带。斜向边沿和越靠近地平线越细小的笔痕承载透视。整体效果朦胧、活跃且发光，色彩颜料的可见分隔是最主要的画风机制。
theme_en: Two figures looking across a glowing industrial harbor at dusk
theme_zh: 两位人物在黄昏凝望发光的工业港湾
name: Maximilien Luce
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
